propositions: Detection channel (canary, ci, review-bot, agent, human-audit, user-report) must be captured at ticket creation via environment variable REBAR_DETECTED_BY or optional --detected-by flag, with explicit flag taking precedence over env
The detected_by field must normalize by strip and lowercase, treat empty/whitespace-only as unset, accept unknown tokens verbatim, and never fail ticket creation
The detected_by field must project present-only into compiled state via process_create mirror, and tickets without it must reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior
The detected_by field must be declared optional in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in env-var/docs registry

Library (_lib_writes.create_ticket), MCP (_mcp_writes.create_ticket), and CLI ingresses must all converge on create_core to receive the stamp, while Jira inbound reconciler (apply_inbound_records.py) correctly bypasses it
